test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct in relation to the bill of exchange?

options.text: Endorser is the person in whose favour the bill is endorsed by the drawer.
Payee is the person to whom the amount of bill is payable.
Drawer is the buyer or debtor.
Drawee is the seller or creditor.

solution:
The correct answer is** Payee is the person to whom the amount of bill is payable.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Payee is the person to whom the amount of bill is payable:**

 
 
• The payee is the individual or entity that is entitled to receive the payment specified in the bill of exchange.
 
• This could be a creditor, supplier, or any party to whom the payment is due.
 
• The payee's name is mentioned on the bill, and they have the legal right to collect the payment from the drawee.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Endorser is the person in whose favour the bill is endorsed by the drawer:**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect. An endorser is the person who signs the back of the bill, transferring the rights to another party.
 
• The person in whose favour the bill is endorsed is called the endorsee, not the endorser.
 
 
 
• **Drawer is the buyer or debtor:**
 
 
• Incorrect. The drawer is actually the person who creates the bill of exchange, typically the seller or creditor.
 
• The drawer instructs the drawee to pay the specified amount to the payee.
 
 
 
• **Drawee is the seller or creditor:**
 
 
• This is false. The drawee is the person or entity upon whom the bill is drawn, usually the buyer or debtor.
 
• The drawee is responsible for paying the amount specified in the bill to the payee.
